programmes.d: The final four teams race through Seoul, South Korea to clinch a spot in the finale and a chance to race for the one million dollar prize.

With the one million dollar prize on the line, the final three teams race to Chicago where they must complete their final challenges within the city's most iconic landmarks, including a trip to Wrigley Field, the home of the World Champion Chicago Cubs.
11 of the most competitive teams in Amazing Race history take on the ultimate challenge for a shot at a Million Dollars.
Racers Dangle from amazing heights to retrieve their first clue in Antwerp Belgium.
Things get slimy at a fishy challenge in Tangiers. Morocco.
How will a pair of Indy Car racers handle a self-drive in Saint-Tropez, France?
The stakes are high as teams face the Double U-Turn.
Racers swap teammates for an entire leg for the first time ever in Amazing Race history!
Will one team's game be on the line when they misplace their passport?
Things get hairy for teams in Hong Kong when tasked with wrangling fifty hairy crabs in the pouring rain.
The Emmy Award-winning THE AMAZING RACE returns with the first reality showdown among some of the most memorable and competitive players from THE AMAZING RACE, SURVIVOR and BIG BROTHER.
Racers have a big decision to make when they face a surprise double U-turn in Laos.
Teams travel to Vietnam where they must master synchronized dancing, karaoke singing and fishing for prawns.
Enemies are made when one team steals another team's taxi in Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam.
